links.outcome: LLM accuracy on vaccine questions by language
links.effect: Mean accuracy across models was 86.0% in English, 83.7% in Spanish, and 80.0% in Chinese; performance also varied by vaccine type and question category.
links.quote: Mean accuracy across models was 86.0% in English, 83.7% in Spanish, and 80.0% in Chinese.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting associated with higher correctness (OR 1.17) and chain-of-thought prompting with lower correctness (OR 0.79) on vaccine questions
Newer flagship models had higher odds of correct answers than earlier models (OR 1.57)

screen.reason: The study empirically tests different prompting strategies (zero-shot vs few-shot vs chain-of-thought) across 13 LLMs on a multilingual vaccine knowledge benchmark to evaluate performance differences.
